translationRepairs: In Kaiyun 2, on the first day bingchen of the fifth summer month, the emperor held court at Chongyuan Hall, received homage, and proclaimed a general amnesty.
In Kaiyun 2, on the first day bingshen of the fifth summer month, the emperor held court at Chongyuan Hall, received homage, and proclaimed a general amnesty.
Chinese 丙申 is bingshen, not bingchen (丙辰); both English fields mistranslate the sexagenary day.

In the second year of Kaiyun, on the first day bingchen of the fifth summer month, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall to receive court homage and proclaimed a general amnesty for all under Heaven.

In the second year of Kaiyun, on the first day bingshen of the fifth summer month, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall to receive court homage and proclaimed a general amnesty for all under Heaven.
Chinese 丙申 is bingshen, not bingchen (丙辰).
On jiayin Zhao Ying became Prefect of Kaifeng; the emperor's brother Chongrui left Kaifeng for Qin; Liu Jixun took Hua; and former Yan commissioner Zhang Cong'en took Jin.
On jiayin Zhao Ying became Prefect of Kaifeng; the emperor's brother Chongrui left Kaifeng for Qin; Liu Jixun took Hua; and former Yun commissioner Zhang Cong'en took Jin.
Chinese 鄆州 is Yun Prefecture; idiomatic wrongly renders it as Yan.

On jiayin, Zhao Ying, military commissioner of Hua Prefecture, was made Prefect of Kaifeng; the emperor's younger brother Chongrui, Prefect of Kaifeng, was made military commissioner of Qin Prefecture; Liu Jixun, commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made military commissioner of Hua Prefecture; Zhang Cong'en, former military commissioner of Yan Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Jin Prefecture.
